name: podrida
description: Podrida: a browser card game. Express + MongoDB backend, Vite + React frontend, one shared TypeScript contract.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @podrida/shared" "npm run dev -w @podrida/backend" "npm run dev -w @podrida/frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @podrida/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @podrida/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @podrida/backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @podrida/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
